title: On Inherent Privacy of Posterior Sampling: A Unified R\'enyi-Divergence Framework
abstract: arXiv:2610.19573v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Differential Privacy (DP) provides a rigorous framework for quantifying privacy guarantees. While most methods achieve DP by injecting calibrated random noise, the intrinsic randomness of certain procedures such as sampling can yield DP guarantees ``for free''. In this work, we develop a unified R\'enyi divergence framework to characterize the inherent DP guarantees of sampling from a Bayesian posterior distribution. We show that the privacy loss incurred by One-Posterior-Sampling (OPS) is governed by posterior exponential moments of the single-record log-likelihood ratio, and establish explicit DP guarantees under uniformly bounded, sub-Gaussian, or sub-exponential tail regimes. translated_title: 论后验采样的固有隐私性：一个统一的Rényi散度框架
translated_abstract: 差分隐私（DP）为量化隐私保证提供了一个严格的框架。虽然大多数方法通过注入经过校准的随机噪声来实现差分隐私，但某些过程（如采样）的内在随机性可以“免费”带来差分隐私保证。在这项工作中，我们开发了一个统一的Rényi散度框架，用于刻画从贝叶斯后验分布中采样的固有差分隐私保证。我们证明，单次后验采样（One-Posterior-Sampling, OPS）所导致的隐私损失由单条记录对数似然比的后验指数矩决定，并在一致有界、次高斯或次指数尾部的情形下建立了显式的差分隐私保证。我们将该框架应用于代表性的贝叶斯模型，包括带任意先验的类别似然模型、高斯-高斯共轭对、来自指数族的广义线性模型以及高斯似然的线性回归等。
tldr: 本文提出统一的Rényi散度框架，证明从贝叶斯后验分布中采样（OPS）天然获得“免费”的差分隐私保证，其隐私损失由单条记录对数似然比的后验指数矩刻画，并在多种尾部条件与代表性贝叶斯模型下给出显式隐私保证。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a unified Rényi-divergence framework showing that One-Posterior-Sampling from a Bayesian posterior inherently provides "free" differential privacy guarantees, where the privacy loss is governed by posterior exponential moments of the single-record log-likelihood ratio, with explicit guarantees under bounded, sub-Gaussian, and sub-exponential tail regimes and across representative Bayesian models.
